reason: A Windows WPF launcher for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that provides an animated startup screen, starts or connects to dsh web, opens the GUI in a browser app window, and manages the launched service lifecycle.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 启动器，提供启动动画、后台服务启动以及浏览器应用窗口打开功能。
summaries.en: A Windows launcher for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that provides a startup animation, starts or connects to the dsh web service, and opens the interface in a browser app window.

capabilities: Launches the dsh web service as a background process
Opens the DSH web GUI in a browser app window
Terminates the launched dsh process tree when the GUI closes
Copies or extracts splash assets to local application directories
Registers a desktop_launch tool for agent-triggered GUI opening
